protocol: Sentence-level syntax judgments, then deterministic all-sentences aggregation
blinding: Only reasoning supplied; no model identity, predicted answer, scenario gold, or constructed target
parsing: Shared explicit numeric parser; original predictions retained as colab_prediction; input files unchanged
superseded_cache: clause_critic_cache.json is from the rejected whole-text pilot and is not used in final results
coverage_audit: All LoRA free-generation texts and all controlled-pair texts reconstructed exactly from critic sentence texts ignoring whitespace. Some base free-generation texts have numbering/formatting or segmentation differences.
limitations: Base free-generation numeric answers parse on 78/100; LoRA 100/100
Syntax critic does not independently validate moral stance or semantic equivalence
These results establish rule learning on these tests, not shared-residual transfer
